name: Icereach Coven (Boss)
related_quests: The Frozen Isle: Brave the island of Icereach and look for survivors.
Pledge: Icereach: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Icereach.
summary: The Icereach Coven serves as the final boss for the Icereach, it consists of Mother Ciannait and the surviving sisters on the island; Sister Bani, Gohlla, Hiti and Maefyn. They need to be stopped from completing their storm ritual.
